## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f37db5978bb26456987badceec3ef7c5a7aca9c2`
Local-runs: probe — on a detached worktree of this head: `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` (71 cases, 10 batteries), `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` (329 cases) and `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` (82 cases), every one exit 0; the three ablations re-run by hand (below, ①.8); a base-vs-head differential of `readMailboxLine` and `seatKey` on 23 lines, run on a second worktree at the merge base `9cd54faae` and on this head (①.1–①.6); after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, `eslint` on the two files exit 0 and all 31 families `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives for the two paths exit 0 (13 direct node, 18 pnpm; among them `check:pm-record-recognisers` = recognisers 329 + check-owed-reviews 63, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 1937 fast-tier, `check:entry-guard`, `check:parse-guard`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check-self-test-wired`, comment-mask corpus 19168 files 0 disagree), the same 31 the dev report counts. The opener's self-test is wired to no CI job (`.github/workflows/lint.yml` names only `check:pm-record-recognisers`), so its 4 new pins could be confirmed no other way. Nothing pushed, nothing written to GitHub, no mailbox opened or closed; both worktrees removed.
Scope: scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (`readSeat` :1281, the three field readers :1333-1355, `readMailboxLine` :1378, the doorbell battery :2577-2624), scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs (`SEAT_LANE_KINDS` / `SEAT_BARE_LANES` / `SEAT_SHAPE` / `RESERVED_DOMAIN_LANE` :166-173, `seatKey` :186, the seat battery :531-541) + scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs (`seatKey` importer :103, `seatSlugOf` :245, `parseSeat` :184-195, read for callers), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md 〈信箱 PR〉 :34-49 and the whole of .claude/skills for a short seat spelling (read, untouched), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md lane table (the four lane kinds), .github/workflows/lint.yml :1262-1274 (which CI step runs the recogniser self-test), scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs register (the tier), and the live mailboxes #27523, #27357, #27309, #27296, #25654 read for every `LANE#N` field and `To:` line on GitHub.

Card #27891, triage 6513886980 (p2 · `domain:skills` · `area:devpath`), claim 6516080492, Contract-review-claim 6516513547 on this head. One commit `f37db597` on `claude/project-thread-sji7vf`; diff against the merge base `9cd54faae`: two files, +40 −12. `check-governed-merges --pr 27986` says NOT governed (no register path), so this record is the seat's own gate before the ordinary queue, as the dispatch order set it; the served tier is the order's, not the register's.

### ① Derived judgments

Each read off the committed tree and, where behaviour is claimed, off the base-vs-head differential (23 lines through `readMailboxLine`, 6 `To:` values through `seatKey`).

1. A well-formed `To: domain:X#N` reads exactly as before: TRUE. `readMailboxLine`'s `To:` path is byte-identical except that `seatKey` now returns null for a reserved `domain:` name (item 5); for `domain:skills#2`, `triage`, `domain:my_lane`, `skills#2` the `to` reading and the refusal are the same on base and head. On the key fields, `domain:skills#2`, `domain:ui#1`, `repo:cloud#1`, `triage#1`, `domain:my_lane#1` (an underscore, which both shapes accept) read on both trees with the same `lane` and `n`; the only addition is `seat.key`, the canonical spelling. The three readers (`notify:seat-online`, `seat-offline`, `split`) are the only callers of `readSeat` on this head; nothing outside `record-recognisers.mjs` imports `readMailboxLine` or `mailboxEvents` (grep over `scripts/`, `.github/`, `package.json`; the one CI mention is the self-test step), and no code reads `seat.n` or `seat.lane` outside the self-test. So no gate, patrol or workflow changes an exit — the file's own ⛔ line (`:1239`) still holds.
2. The short form is refused everywhere: TRUE. `skills#2` and a bare `server` in a key field move from `read` (base: `{ lane: 'skills', n: 2 }`) to `unreadable` with reason `does not spell …`, matching the `To:` line's existing `refused` (`names no seat`). `SEAT_REF` is gone from the tree (grep: no definition, no reader). The ruling's one-grammar line is met: both envelope and key fields go through `seatKey` and no second shape remains.
3. Bare `triage` reads n = 1, not null — RIGHT, and a pure canonicalisation. Downstream: no consumer of `seat.n` exists outside the battery (item 1), so nothing branched on null. The forms text names seats `LANE#N` and the roster's `parseSeat` already reads an absent number as 1 (`fleet-roster.mjs:191`, `?? 1`), as does `seatKey` for `To:` (`triage` → `triage#1`, pinned since #27881). A null here was the one place in the fleet where seat 1 was spelled as no seat. Existing records on GitHub: every `LANE#N` field on the five `pm:mailbox` PRs (open #27523, #27357, #27309; closed #27296, #25654) is a full `domain:X#N` (`domain:skills#2`, `domain:ui#1..4`, `domain:server#1`); none is bare or short-form, so no live record read differently. The self-test fixture that pinned null (`a seat with no number reads (triage)`) is rewritten by the diff to pin `n === 1 && key === 'triage#1'`, and no other fixture depended on null. Accepted as part of the ruling, not a deviation.
4. The accepted set is NOT purely narrowed — one widening, correct but mis-stated. The PR body and 维护者速读 say "nothing new is accepted". On the key fields, a lane name with a dot was UNREADABLE on base (`SEAT_REF` had no `.` in its class) and READS on head via `seatKey` (`[a-z0-9._-]`): `repo:www.objectos.ai#2` (a real board seat, fixture `fleet-roster.mjs:607`) and `domain:a.b#1`. This is the one-grammar outcome the ruling asked for (the `To:` line already accepted it) and harms nothing, but the body's claim is wrong on this point. Also, a mixed-case key field (`Domain:Skills#2`) read with `lane: 'Domain:Skills'` on base and reads `domain:skills` on head — lower-casing as `To:` already did. `Clause-②: no` is still right: `scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing. Should-fix 1.
5. Reserved `domain:` names refused: TRUE and complete. `RESERVED_DOMAIN_LANE` is `^(?:(?:triage|director)$|(?:repo)-)`, built from the same two lists as `SEAT_SHAPE`, applied only to the name after `domain:`. Completeness against the slug map (`domain:X#N` → `X-N`; `repo:Y#N` → `repo-Y-N`; `triage#N` → `triage-N`; `director#N` → `director-N`, with the name class excluding `:` and `#` and N a digit run): within one kind the slug is injective; the only cross-kind collisions are `domain:triage` ↔ `triage`, `domain:director` ↔ `director` and `domain:repo-Y` ↔ `repo:Y`, which is exactly the refused set. Differential: `domain:triage` on `To:` moved from `read` (key `domain:triage#1`, slug `triage-1` — the triage seat's) to `refused`; `domain:repo-cloud` likewise (slug `repo-cloud-1`); in a key field both move to `unreadable`. `domain:triage-tools#1`, `domain:directory`, `domain:repository` still read (the pins at `mailbox-open.mjs:538`). Also narrowed, as intended by the four-kind shape: `epic:x#1` read on base and is refused on head — `epic:` is a label kind, never a seat lane.
6. One spelling of the lane words, no re-spelled duplicate: TRUE. `SEAT_LANE_KINDS` and `SEAT_BARE_LANES` are exported from `mailbox-open.mjs`; `SEAT_SHAPE` and `RESERVED_DOMAIN_LANE` are both built from them, pinned by `mailbox-open.mjs:539`. Elsewhere on the head the lane kinds are spelled only in prose: `fleet-roster.mjs:26-28` (header) and `parseSeat` reads the lane as the seat post's first `kind:name` token with no word list; the pm-dispatch SKILL.md lane table; `MAILBOX_KEYS`' `from`/`to` prose. No code duplicate exists, so there was nothing to import (the dispatch order's "import rather than re-spell" is met by construction). The two exports have no importer yet — see should-fix 2.
7. `record-recognisers.mjs` ↔ `mailbox-open.mjs` graph: the edge already existed on main (#27881); this diff adds no import. No cycle.
8. Self-tests and ablations, reproduced: mailbox-open 71 cases (was 67; the 4 new ones are the short-form, reserved-name, contains-a-word and one-list pins at `:536-539`), record-recognisers 329 (was 326; 3 new at `:2614-2616`, one reworded at `:2613`). Ablations, each run once by me and the tree restored by `git checkout`: (a) drop the reserved refusal line in `seatKey` → mailbox-open 2 failures (`:537`, `:539`), recognisers 1 of 329 (`:2616`); (b) `readSeat` falls back to the old loose shape when `seatKey` is null → recognisers 2 of 329 (`:2615`, `:2616`), mailbox-open green; (c) `readSeat` drops `key` → recognisers 3 of 329 (`:2613`, `:2614`, `:2616`). Exactly the three failure sets the dev report claims. The recognisers' reserved pin runs in CI (`Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` → `check:pm-record-recognisers`), so the refusal is CI-covered transitively even though the opener's own battery is not.
9. `project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 reads right untouched: its three doorbell lines spell `LANE#N` and the envelope `To: 席位`, never a short form; the self-test that every key template is verbatim in the text still passes (329 green). A grep of all of `.claude/skills` and AGENTS.md for a short seat spelling (`skills#2`-like, not preceded by `domain:`/`repo:`) finds nothing. No rule text now reads wrong; `check:pm-skill-id-lint` is not triggered (no `.claude/**` edit).
10. Scope and declarations: the diff is exactly the two files the claim lists; PR body carries `Fixes #27891`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, the six 速读 lines, and says the review is owed and the tier is the register's. Label `skip-changeset`, Check Changeset green. The PR cites a `dispatch-gates --commands` run from the merge base; main is 8 commits ahead and `ci.yml`/`lint.yml` moved in that range (the tool warns STALE TREE on this head), but none of those 8 commits touches the two files, `fleet-roster.mjs` or `project-forms.md`; `git merge-tree origin/main HEAD` is clean.

### ② Semver level

No package publishes from `scripts/pm/**`; `Clause-②: no`, `skip-changeset`, no changeset, Check Changeset green. Consistent; no level to declare. (The accepted-set widening in ①.4 is on an internal PM reader, not a published surface.)

### ③ Boundary flags

- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; attribution comment names os-elon-musk. No non-bot login to record.
- Dev report deviations, each answered: (1) assignee/reviewer not set — consistent with the no-MCP-write posture, accepted; (2) bare `triage` n = 1 not null — ruled right in ①.3; (3) `skip-changeset` rode on `pr_create` — the gates derive no changeset for `scripts/pm/**`, accepted. `open_questions`: none. `out_of_scope_findings`: none.
- Model: the order said default (opus); the report says fable, by the project rule for cards that may touch `.claude/**`. The card did not touch `.claude/**` in the end; no effect on the review.
- The PR body's "nothing new is accepted" is over-stated (①.4); the landing ACCEPT should name the dotted-lane widening so the record is exact. Not a must-fix: the widening is the ruling's one grammar, and the file is governed by no register row.
- Dispatch-gates derivation on this head reads a tree 8 commits behind main with `ci.yml` and `lint.yml` changed since; the PR's CI ran the merge with main, which is the reading that counts (②-gate below).
- The opener's self-test is still wired to no CI job (as record 6513700361 noted); run here as the Local-runs probe. Should-fix 3.
- Contract-review-claim 6516513547 names this session and this head; the only comment on the PR; no competing claim, no hold.
- CI on `f37db597` (REST `commits/SHA/check-runs`, final poll at the end of this review): 46 check runs, 26 success, 20 skipped by path filter, 0 in progress, 0 failures. Green: Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI/release/engine gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests / query-options erasure / slot lookup & corpus, Lint & Repo Gates, Type Check × 5, Test Core (1/8) and (2/8), Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, Auto Label, filter. Condition ② of the landing check is met on this head.
- Draft PR, `mergeable_state: blocked`, auto-merge not armed. Not governed, so after this PASS the seat lands it through the ordinary queue.

### ④ Design judgment

Rules-text face: none in `hits` (`project-forms.md` untouched and verified to read right in ①.9). The tooling that enforces the forms text is the whole diff, judged against the card's three Wanted items and the triage ruling:

- `record-recognisers.mjs` `readSeat` — one grammar, by delegation to `seatKey` and deriving `lane`/`n` from the canonical `key` rather than keeping a parallel regex: the right shape, since a second regex is what the card was filed against. The reading gains `key` so a consumer can compare seats without re-joining the halves. The doorbell battery pins the well-formed line, the short form in all three key kinds and on `To:`, the reserved names in both places, and the contains-a-word case; each pin is load-bearing (①.8). Holds.
- `mailbox-open.mjs` `seatKey` — the reserved set is derived from the slug map's actual collisions and from the same lists as the shape, not hand-listed, so adding a lane kind or bare lane later moves both together; the test at `:539` pins that property. The header's one-to-one claim is now enforced where the slug is made, which is what should-fix 4 of 6513700361 asked. Holds.
- Scenario check: a message `To: domain:triage` that would have landed in the triage seat's branch namespace is now refused at the envelope; `Notify: split · skills#2 · …` that read while `To: skills#2` was refused is now refused too, with the same `does not spell` reason the template already carries. Both match the triage ruling verbatim.

No schema or ADR in `hits`; no first-consumer or execution-plan judgment is owed.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-sji7vf`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Must-fix: none.

Should-fix:
1. PR body / 速读 and the landing ACCEPT: the claim "nothing new is accepted" is not exact. On the key fields a dotted lane name (`repo:www.objectos.ai#2`, a real seat; `domain:a.b#1`) was unreadable on main and reads now, and a mixed-case field is now lower-cased in `seat.lane`. Both are the one-grammar outcome and correct; name them in the ACCEPT so the review record and the body agree. No code change.
2. `SEAT_LANE_KINDS` / `SEAT_BARE_LANES` are exported with no importer; `fleet-roster.mjs` `parseSeat` reads a seat post's lane as its first token with no word list, so a fifth lane kind on a seat post would be read by the roster and refused by the mailbox. A follow-up could have the roster's self-test assert every fixture lane's kind is in the exported lists (or `parseSeat` reject a kind outside them), making the lists the one spelling in fact and not only in `mailbox-open.mjs`.
3. `mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` (now 71 cases, 4 of them this card's) is still run by no CI job; only the recognisers' reserved pin covers the refusal in CI. Wiring the opener's self-test into `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` is a one-line follow-up (`check-self-test-wired` is green only because the opener is not on CI's script list).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：信箱读者只剩一种席位写法。`record-recognisers.mjs` 里门铃键字段的席位改由 `seatKey` 解析，删掉 `SEAT_REF`，于是 `skills#2` 这类简写在键字段里和在 `To:` 行里一样被拒。`mailbox-open.mjs` 的 `seatKey` 拒收与保留车道词同名的 `domain:` 名（`domain:triage` / `director` / `repo-…`），车道词表导出为 `SEAT_LANE_KINDS` / `SEAT_BARE_LANES`。2 个文件，+40/−12。
- 为什么改：PR #27881 之后，同一条消息可以用两种拼法写收件席，但只有一种能被读到：`To: skills#2` 被拒，`Notify: split · skills#2 · …` 却能读。
- 风险与回滚：不加门禁。写法规范的 `To: domain:X#N` 读法不变。行为上有三处变化，都是统一写法的应有结果：①键字段里带点的车道名（如名册夹具里的真实席位 `repo:www.objectos.ai#2`）以前读不出，现在能读；②大小写混写的键字段，`seat.lane` 现在统一为小写；③单写 `triage` 读作第 1 席，不再是空。线上 5 个 `pm:mailbox` PR 都用全称，没有记录依赖旧读法。revert 即回滚。
- 先看：`record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `readSeat`，再看 `mailbox-open.mjs` 的 `seatKey`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`（329）与 `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`（71）均 exit 0。
- 需要你做的：无。登记册判定本 PR 不在受管面，契约复核 PASS（记录在本评论之前，`Head-sha: f37db5978bb26456987badceec3ef7c5a7aca9c2`），由本席转 ready 并开自动合并。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核 PASS，没有 must-fix。should-fix 1（PR 正文说「不接受新写法」不够准确）已在本评论的风险一行写明，不改代码。should-fix 2、3（`mailbox-open` 自测没接进 CI，导出的车道词表没人引用）转到跟进卡 #27997。CI 全绿。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** one PR, `Fixes #27891`, two files: `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`; `skip-changeset`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27986`: NOT governed; ordinary queue landing.
- **前提实测:** `readSeat` has exactly three callers (the seat-online, seat-offline and split readers). `seatKey` is imported only by `fleet-roster` (`seatSlugOf`) and the recognisers. Nothing outside the recognisers reads `seat.n` / `seat.lane`. The reserved set is exactly the cross-kind slug collisions (`domain:triage`↔`triage`, `domain:director`↔`director`, `domain:repo-Y`↔`repo:Y`), built from the same lists as `SEAT_SHAPE` (review ①).
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `f37db5978bb26456987badceec3ef7c5a7aca9c2`: 46 check-runs, 26 success, 20 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. Locally 31 derived families exit 0. Three ablations each fail the intended pins.
- **接受的偏差:** none. `project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 spells `LANE#N` / `To: 席位` and reads right, so it is untouched.
- **范围外去向:** #27997 (`pm:blocked` on this PR): wire `mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` into an existing CI script, and pin the roster fixture lanes against the exported lists.
- **落地条款:** not on the register, so the ordinary queue applies: the seat flips it ready and arms auto-merge on the contract review PASS, under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (seat thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z).
